plan: Considering my value of $39, the optimal strategy is to bid slightly below my value to maximize profit if I win. Other bidders likely have values between $0 and $49. To ensure winning, I will bid $38, as it is close to my value and increases the chance of winning by outbidding others while maintaining a good profit margin. This strategy assumes other bidders will bid close to their values.

With a value of $27, I aim to bid slightly below my value to maximize profit while increasing my chances of winning. Assume others bid close to their values. If I bid $26, I win if others bid below $26. If others bid higher, I lose but don't pay. If I bid too low, I risk losing a potential profit. Bidding $26 balances risk and reward.

Given my value of $13, I aim to maximize profit by winning only if the third-highest bid is significantly lower. I expect others to bid close to their values. If I bid slightly above half my value, e.g., $7, I might win if others undervalue their bids. This balances the risk of overpaying and the chance of winning with profit. I will bid $7, hoping the third bid is lower, thus securing a profit if I win.
